prompt:
Answer all questions in one sentence.
From the case study, “Paper or Plastic”: It was widely accepted that paper cups were a more sustainable option than Styrofoam cups. Explain why this might not necessarily be the case.

Explain why only humans generate waste.

What is meant by the waste stream?
judge_reasoning: Candidate 1 is the only response that meaningfully answers all three requested parts (paper vs. Styrofoam, “only humans generate waste,” and the definition of the waste stream), though it violates the “one sentence” constraint by using three sentences. Candidate 2 is heavily detailed about the cup comparison but omits the other two questions entirely. Candidate 3 mainly discusses non-human waste management and does not directly explain the specific claim in the prompt, and Candidate 4 shifts to household waste-management steps rather than the requested sustainability/waste-stream/humans-waste explanations.
